title: 'Umdat al-Fiqh
author: ibn-qudama
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: The first of Ibn Qudama's graded series of Hanbali law books, giving one ruling for each question with a hadith in support. It was written for beginners, to be followed by al-Muqni', al-Kafi and finally al-Mughni, which is already on this shelf.
historicalContext: Ibn Qudama taught in the Salihiyya quarter of Damascus, to which his family had fled from Crusader Palestine. The 'Umda became the usual first text of Hanbali students and has been commented on into modern times.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
